name: Stage 12: Vattgruvan to Yngsviken
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 12, Vattgruvan to Yngsviken.
utilities: Vattgruvan/Vattgruvsmossen and Yngsviken are access/parking points rather than service nodes. Exact stage access by public transport is awkward.

Vattgruvsmossen parking is verified but small; OSM maps about 3 spaces. Road access is via Billsta/road 57, and Länsstyrelsen notes the road/parking has been improved while some approach-road sections remain poor.
Vattgruvsmossen has an accessible toilet/changing-table point by the parking according to Naturkartan/OSM and recent trail comments, making it the strongest confirmed toilet on the core stage.
For public transport, practical approaches are adding stage 11 from Järna, using the stage 12:1 connector from Mölnbo, or arranging pickup/taxi near Yngsviken.

Stora Alsjön reserve parking gives a useful side access and local-loop option, but it is not the same as the Yngsviken endpoint. Naturkartan describes about 6 cars at Stora Alsjön parking; Yngsviken has official parking/access, but exact parking geometry and capacity are under-mapped.
No shops are on the stage. Mölnbo/24Food via stage 12:1 and Järna before stage 11 are the nearest rail-side resupply options.
Högfors and Molstaberg bus stops are only side-access context and not clean trailheads. Verify live service and walking routes before treating them as exits.
waterSources: No verified potable tap was found on core stage 12. Carry water and treat/filter natural sources.

Trönsjön is described by Sörmlandsleden as having good-quality water, rest, and bathing, and municipal water data reports high ecological status, but it is still natural lake water and Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee it. Treat/filter/boil and carry backup.

Stora Kobäcken, Lilla Horssjön, Stora Horssjön, Stora Alsjön, and nearby Yngern are natural surface water only; do not label them as drinking-water taps. Vindskyddskartan specifically treats Lilla Horssjön water quality as unknown.

OSM has isolated off-route drinking-water/water-point nodes near Sjundasjön/Almvik, but multiple research passes found no official or on-stage corroboration. Do not rely on them without field verification.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Officially 8.5 km but demanding: repeated rocky climbs/descents over hällmark, steep lake-shore sections at Stora Alsjön, and a steep descent toward Yngsviken make this slower than the distance suggests. AllTrails rates the route hard/challenging at about 8.9 km and 304 m gain; use that as effort context, not the canonical distance.

Distance sources disagree: official/Naturkartan list 8.5 km, Äventyrligare and AllTrails are around 8.3-8.9 km, OSM relation 2390742 measures about 8.36 km but is still tagged 9.5 km, and official full-GPX extraction can under-measure around 7.98 km from simplification/snap differences. Use the official distance and current markings.

For route drawing, use OSM/Naturkartan topology but override stale distance metadata: Stage 12 should run from the Vattgruvan Stage 11/12 shared node around 59.082122, 17.449356 to the Yngsviken Stage 12/13 shared node around 59.108280, 17.379178. Store the printed official start 59.082017,17.449867 separately, but snap topology to the shared OSM node.

At the Stage 12:1 junction around 59.081138, 17.426726, show a clear T-junction: east/northeast toward Vattgruvan/Järna, west toward Yngsviken, and south on connector 12:1 toward Mölnbo. Do not merge Mölnbo station access into Stage 12 or Stage 12:1's official distance; 12:1 is Mölnbo IP to Stage 12, with Mölnbo station as an extra access connector.
Near Vattgruvan, smaller mine holes are not fenced and larger shafts sit near the route. Stay on marked trail and keep children/dogs close.

Vattgruvsmossen rules include dogs leashed, no camping more than two consecutive nights, fires only at designated places, no disturbing wildlife, no off-road driving, and no damaging vegetation, dead wood, rock, or soil. The reserve is also Natura 2000 SE0110006.

Stora Alsjön reserve/Natura 2000 rules require fires only at designated fireplaces and prohibit damaging/removing living or dead wood, rock, soil, plants, mosses, lichens, and wood-living fungi. Motor vehicles are limited to roads. Flowers, berries, and edible mushrooms are allowed, but firewood boxes may be empty and wood collection is not allowed.

Stora Alsjön reserve water/fishing rights are not clearly open to hikers; reserve-plan material ties fishing to landowners and sources do not establish public fishing rights. Do not recommend fishing unless the user has explicit current permission. If continuing into Stora Envättern, fishing is explicitly prohibited.

A January 2024 user report praised the Stora Alsjön north shelter location but noted wet-floor/design issues; a 2024 overnight report also questioned weather protection at Stora Alsjön and wind exposure at Lilla Horssjön. Treat shelters as useful but not stormproof.
A 2024 comment reported a missing/downed sign about 1 km before Yngsviken; the official page showed no current fault report during the 2026-04-28 research pass.

Recent Vattgruvan loop comments add dated condition warnings: a 2025-09-14 user report described sunken/disintegrated boardwalks after wet weather and felled spruce with no cut-through, while a 2025-07-19 comment emphasized water scarcity for overnighting. Vardagstur's 2024 account also reported bark-beetle affected forest and detours around fallen trees north/east toward the Yngsviken/Djupsjön direction. Treat these as user-reported conditions, not official closures, and be cautious in wind.

Do not confuse Stage 12 with nearby branches/continuations and local loops: Vattgruvsmossen/Vattgruvan loops near the start, the 12:1 Mölnbo connector, Stora Alsjön blue/local trails, and Stage 13/Djupsjön facilities all need separate route-builder treatment. The official Vattgruvan round loop is a separate 9 km suggestion that only partly uses Sörmlandsleden, and OSM relation 20109615 should not be merged into Stage 12.

Horssjöarna naming is inconsistent in sources: map data and official coordinates place the shelter at Lilla Horssjön, while one steward note says Stora Horssjön. Keep the shelter at Lilla Horssjön and treat Stora Horssjön as fire/rest context unless field-verified.

facilities.name: Vattgruvan stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start at Vattgruvan/Vattgruvsmossen. Road access is signed from road 57/Billsta, but approach-road conditions can be rough.

facilities.name: Vattgruvsmossen parking
facilities.description: Small parking by the reserve/stage start; OSM maps about 3 spaces while official text says good parking at Yngsviken/Vattgruvan. Approach road is improved but still rough in places, and current local signs should be checked.

facilities.name: Vattgruvsmossen accessible toilet
facilities.description: Accessible toilet/changing-table point by the parking, confirmed by Naturkartan/OSM and recent trail comments. Treat as the strongest confirmed toilet on core Stage 12.

facilities.name: Vattgruvan mine-hole warning
facilities.description: Hazard/rule marker: old mine field with several smaller unfenced mine holes near the trail and larger fenced shafts off trail. Keep children/dogs close and be extra cautious in snow, dusk, or poor visibility.

facilities.name: Stage 12 geometry/source caveat
facilities.description: OSM relation 2390742 is topologically useful but still tagged 9.5 km; measured OSM geometry is about 8.36 km, while official/Naturkartan list 8.5 km and official full-GPX extraction can under-measure around 7.98 km. Clip Stage 12 to Vattgruvan-Yngsviken and keep Vattgruvan loops separate.

facilities.name: Vattgruvsmossen reserve/Natura rules
facilities.description: Reserve/Natura 2000 SE0110006 context: dogs leashed, camping max two consecutive nights, fires only at designated sites, no off-road driving, no disturbing wildlife, and no damaging vegetation, dead wood, rock, soil, mosses, lichens, or wood fungi.

facilities.name: Vattgruvan local-loop caveat
facilities.description: The official Vattgruvan round loop is a separate 9 km suggestion that only partly follows Sörmlandsleden. OSM also has Vattgruvan rundslinga, Vattgruvsmossen, Blå leden, and Kolbottenrundan relations nearby; do not merge these into Stage 12.

facilities.name: Stora Kobäcken shelter
facilities.description: Shelter/rest area about 250-300 m beyond the start with benches, boardwalk to water, nearby tenting, and about 4 sleeping places in shelter-map data. First-come; pack out waste. Recent reports say tent pegging can be awkward on rocky ground.

facilities.name: Stora Kobäcken fireplace
facilities.description: Designated fireplace at Stora Kobäcken. Naturkartan/Länsstyrelsen context says bring your own firewood; current fire bans and local fire-risk guidance override use.

facilities.name: Stora Kobäcken natural water
facilities.description: Lake/tjärn water at the rest area; quality is not verified as potable. Treat/filter/boil.

facilities.name: Vattgruvsmossen entrance fireplace/picnic
facilities.description: Additional mapped fireplace/picnic context near the Vattgruvsmossen entrance. Medium confidence; use only where signs and current fire-ban status allow.

facilities.name: Kristinagruvan / Järna gruvor
facilities.description: Mining-history point near the early part of the stage. Treat mine remains as hazardous protected heritage.

facilities.name: Etapp 12:1 junction to Mölnbo
facilities.description: Connector junction for the 4 km Mölnbo IP route; show Mölnbo station as a separate access spur beyond the official 12:1 start. This is the most practical rail approach to the middle of Stage 12. Official GPX nearest point is around 59.080787,17.426609, so allow small snap tolerance.

facilities.name: Trönsjön rest, swim, and natural water
facilities.description: Rest/swim area where Sörmlandsleden notes good-quality water. It is still natural lake water, not a potable tap; treat/filter.

facilities.name: Stora Horssjön fire/rest point
facilities.description: Mapped fire/rest context at Stora Horssjön. Do not treat this as a shelter; sources place the confirmed shelter at Lilla Horssjön despite one official steward note using Stora Horssjön wording.

facilities.name: Stora Alsjön viewpoint/rest
facilities.description: View/rest point near Stora Alsjön terrain. Fires and wood use are restricted by reserve rules.

facilities.name: Stora Alsjön reserve/Natura rules
facilities.description: Reserve/Natura 2000 SE0110161 context: fires only at designated places; do not damage or remove live/dead wood, vegetation, mosses, lichens, wood-living fungi, rock, or soil; motor vehicles only on roads; do not assume fishing rights are open.

facilities.name: Horssjöarna tent/rest area
facilities.description: Officially recommended tent/rest/bathing area between the Horssjö lakes, with tenting west of the trail. Use durable ground and avoid crowding.

facilities.name: Lilla Horssjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter about 150 m east of the trail between the Horssjö lakes; first-come and no guaranteed firewood. Vindskyddskartan notes bathing/rest context, unknown-quality water, difficult foot-only access over stones, and possible exposure to cold wind. Some source text says Stora Horssjön, but coordinates/map sources support Lilla Horssjön.

facilities.name: Lilla Horssjön fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace by Lilla Horssjön shelter; use only if current fire-ban status and reserve rules allow.

facilities.name: Alsjöklint viewpoint
facilities.description: Viewpoint near the demanding Stora Alsjön terrain; approximate side/rest feature.

facilities.name: Stora Alsjön north shelter
facilities.description: Newer shelter/rest area on the north headland of Stora Alsjön with benches, view, and fireplace. Strong location but dated user-reported wet-floor/design/weather-protection complaints. Firewood bin is reported about 100 m north/up-trail, but Naturkartan says stock is not guaranteed; bring your own.

facilities.name: Stora Alsjön north fireplace
facilities.description: Designated fireplace at Stora Alsjön north point. Fires only at designated places and current fire bans override use.

facilities.name: Stora Alsjön natural water
facilities.description: Lake water at the shelter area; not a verified drinking-water tap. Treat/filter/boil.

facilities.name: Stora Alsjön reserve parking
facilities.description: Side access/parking for Stora Alsjön reserve and local loop, separate from the official Yngsviken endpoint. Länsstyrelsen says it is reached from Molstabergsvägen west of the reserve, and Naturkartan describes about 6 cars and an information board.

facilities.name: Yngsviken parking and stage 13 start
facilities.description: Stage-end access and official parking at the stage 13 start. Official Stage 12 calls it good parking, but exact car-park footprint/capacity is under-mapped and no nearby regular public transport or toilet was verified.

facilities.name: Yngsviken Stage 12/13 join
facilities.description: Shared Stage 12/13 topology node. End Stage 12 here; do not include Topo GPS-style extra tails or Stage 13/Djupsjön facilities in core Stage 12.

facilities.name: Yngsviken missing-sign caution
facilities.description: A 2024 official comment reported a missing/damaged sign about 1 km before Yngsviken. No official current fault is listed, but keep navigation attention high near the endpoint until field-verified.

facilities.name: Högfors side-access bus
facilities.description: Closest OSM bus stop found by straight line to Vattgruvan, around 3 km away and not a clean trailhead. Verify live service and walking route before relying on it.

facilities.name: Molstaberg side-access bus
facilities.description: Distant side-access bus context south/west of the reserve road network. Far from core Stage 12; verify live service and route before using it.

facilities.name: Hunting season awareness
facilities.description: Hiking is not forbidden during hunting, but during active hunting periods, especially from the large moose hunt starting 8 October, watch for signs, many parked cars, or local notices and choose another area if hunting appears active.

facilities.name: Stora Envättern continuation warning
facilities.description: Stage 13 continuation context, not core Stage 12: Länsstyrelsen warns of bark-beetle-damaged spruce that can fall suddenly, especially in wind; fishing is prohibited and toilet status at the reserve parking is changing/uncertain.

facilities.name: Yngsviken information boards
facilities.description: Endpoint information-board context near the Yngsviken road crossing and parking/access area.

facilities.name: Myssjö gård side service
facilities.description: Nearby paid accommodation/activity provider reached by continuing toward stage 13 and side roads; not on core stage 12, not a public shop/resupply point, and no nearby public transport is claimed.
